//: Exists so firestore.rules and firestore.indexes.json can actually be deployed. Before this file they lived in the repo with no path to Firebase at all — rules had to be pasted into the console by hand, and indexes were never declared anywhere, which is why a query could fail on the server while the cache made it look like it had briefly worked. Deploy with: npm run deploy:firestore
//storage: Declared so storage.rules can be deployed at all; the bucket's rules used to exist only in the console. Deliberately NOT picked up by the GitHub Action or by npm run deploy:firestore, both of which pass --only firestore. Deploy it by hand, once, with: npm run deploy:storage -- and read the warning in storage.rules first, because that command OVERWRITES whatever the console currently says.
